description: Approved plan .mastracode/plans/om-anthropic-token-calibration.md. Compare o200k and tokenx against real Claude/non-Claude provider usage; attribute reported 59k versus 30k activation to tokenizer, gating or request overhead. Runtime changes gated on measurement. Independent review and commit-bound verifier required.

comments.text:
Rejected calibration candidate preserved and original runtime restored. The live gate failed at 18,508 adjusted provider tokens for Opus 5.5 with factor 1.55; sol remained at 29,976 with factor 1.0. Source evidence is /tmp/om-token-calibration/live/report.md and results.json, as recorded in the revised plan.

Offline fixed-factor evidence in /tmp/om-token-calibration/factor-viability/report.md reconstructed 912 traced pre-activation pending counts. Its readiness model reproduced 34 of 36 activation checks, so counterfactual results remain inferred. The fixture ratio was 1.2411 versus historical pooled 1.5522 across 617 strict pairs from 108 sessions. No tested constant satisfied every evaluable historical session and the fixture. These are not live passes and do not prove impossibility for every narrower traffic mix. Fixed-factor calibration is rejected under the current acceptance contract.

All nine candidate files were byte-identical to independently reviewed /tmp/om-calibration-rereview.SjA20B at baseline 56a59044c47f8a9d54f834852e927e99cf90cda9. The recoverable archive is /tmp/om-token-calibration/rejected-candidate, including relative-path copies, binary patch, untracked tar, hashes and restoration manifest. Six tracked edits were restored to HEAD and only the three archived task-created files were removed. The revised .mastracode plan is unchanged. Archive hash checks, HEAD byte comparisons and recovery patch applicability passed. Restored package checks passed with 6 suites and 67 tests, typecheck and lint. No provider calls, credentials, source commits or PRs.

Scope remains blocked awaiting revised activation semantics, including the decision between a hard per-request acceptance band and best-effort activation around 30k. A last-sent provider-usage trigger is not approved. Keep this issue in progress, not closed or fixed. No new implementation is authorized by this cleanup.

Current work supersedes the rejected synthetic-fixture outcome. Bryan requested native Pi real-provider runs without transport changes, and set a 25k adjusted sent-input floor, preferably 27k; late readiness/safe-swap delays are acceptable. Native pricing/UI calibration rejected 1.55 after a 20,903-token activation. Frozen 1.40 produced pricing 32,597/36,406 and UI 37,350/37,522/40,061, with unsent tokens separate. Native Sol baseline/candidate completed at 29,384/30,670 with natural tests 58/58 and 44/44; reference graders fail on an unrequested helper export. Held-out returns-policy is still running; no acceptance claim yet. Runtime/index match frozen sources; config differs only in comments and equivalent 1.40/1.4 spelling. Fresh independent review approved mechanics; exact-copy root lint, 2,332 tests and typecheck passed. Repro commit 6a6d515 precedes pending fix commit. Final held-out audit and commit-bound verdict remain required. Evidence /tmp/om-native-calibration.mYBL7l and tracked calibration plan. Opus 4.6 prohibited in every role. Abandoned eval transport/compression code moved out of repo and will not ship.

Native Pi evidence audited with no additional calls. Frozen 1.40 held-out adjusted sent inputs: 30680, 35216, 39297, 40528, 44278, 44133; all exceed preferred 27000 floor. Initial request 4725 is an overhead proxy, not exact system/tool count. Separate unsent o200k and following gross usage are recorded in package docs and /tmp/om-native-calibration.mYBL7l/all-boundaries.json. Source hashes and expected main/observer routes verified; no 4.6 calls. Run hit predeclared 140-request cap after 11/17 prompts, exit 70 REQUEST_LIMIT; censored/incomplete, not a task pass. Partial natural 133/135 and reference 143/157. Bryan accepts six observed activations as sufficient. Sol baseline/candidate 29384/30670; natural suites 58/58 and 44/44. No more runs, continuation, tuning, padding or cap increase. Final root lint, 2332 tests and typecheck passed; final commit and SHA-bound review/verdict pending.
